title: Lateen asset manifest
description: What each route of the performance fixture loads on one commit: one row per stylesheet, island module, inline script, and font file, with raw and gzip bytes. Routes are ordered by URL and each route's assets by path; a path appears at most once per route by convention, which a schema cannot enforce and the test checks. No clock is recorded, so two runs on the same commit write the same file.

commit.description: The commit the manifest describes. It identifies the run instead of a timestamp.

mizzen.description: The @velella/mizzen version that built the fixture.

path.description: A path from the output folder, or inline:<n> for an inline script.
